# Shaurya Tools

> Free browser-based tools for developers, creators, students, and everyday tasks. Tools run directly in the browser where possible, with no login required.

Shaurya Tools provides focused utilities for formatting, generating, converting, calculating, writing, image editing, and SEO workflows. Each tool has a stable direct URL and a descriptive page title.

## Important Pages

- [Homepage](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/): Browse and search all available tools.
- [XML Sitemap](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Complete crawlable URL inventory.

## Social Media

- [Hashtag Generator](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/hashtag-generator): Generate trending hashtags for Instagram, YouTube, and Twitter.
- [Instagram Bio](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/instagram-bio-generator): Create catchy, emoji-rich bios for your social profiles.
- [YT Description](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/youtube-description-generator): SEO descriptions for YouTube videos to rank higher.
- [LinkedIn Post](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/linkedin-post-generator): Write professional LinkedIn posts that boost engagement.
- [Caption Gen](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/social-media-caption-generator): Engaging captions for all social platforms with hashtags.
- [YT Title Optimizer](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/youtube-title-optimizer): High-CTR titles for YouTube videos using AI keywords.

## AI Tools

- [Prompt Generator](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/prompt-generator): Get perfect AI prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, and Midjourney.
- [Blog Post Generator](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/blog-post-generator): Transform a simple headline into a full-length, SEO-optimized blog post with AI-powered structure.

## Development

- [README Generator](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/readme-generator): Generate a professional GitHub README.md file instantly.
- [Code Minifier](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/code-minifier): Minify HTML, CSS, and JS to improve site performance.

- [.gitignore Gen](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/gitignore-generator): Create .gitignore files for any framework or language.
- [License Gen](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/license-generator): Generate MIT, GNU, or Apache open-source licenses.
- [Meta Tag Gen](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/metatag-generator): Generate SEO meta tags and social media open graph cards.
- [Profile README](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/profile-readme-generator): Design a stunning GitHub profile with stats and badges.
- [Code Prettifier](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/code-prettifier): Format and beautify your code instantly for better readability and clean structure.
- [Code Explainer](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/code-explainer): Paste complex code snippets and get a plain-English breakdown of how the logic works step-by-step.
- [Code To Document](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/code-to-document): Instantly convert your source code into professional technical documentation, READMEs, or API references.
- [Error Debugger](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/error-debugger): Paste your error logs or broken code to identify the root cause and get optimized, working solutions instantly.

## Utilities

- [QR Code Gen](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/qr-code-generator): Generate QR codes for URLs, WiFi, and V-Cards.
- [Unit Converter](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/unit-converter): Quickly convert metric and imperial measurements.
- [Age Calculator](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/age-calculator): Find out your exact age in years, months, and days.
- [Retro Flip Clock](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/flip-clock): A stylish, full-screen retro flip clock for your workspace. Perfect for focus sessions, livestream backgrounds, or a minimalist desk setup.
- [Fuel Expense Calculator](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/fuel-expense-calculator): Calculate the total cost of your trip or monthly commute. Factor in distance, fuel efficiency, and current gas prices to optimize your travel budget.
- [Electricity Bill Estimator](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/electricity-bill-estimator): Forecast your monthly utility costs. Input your appliance usage and local unit rates to see a detailed breakdown of your power consumption.
- [AI Image Compressor](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/image-compressor): Reduce image file size by up to 90% without losing quality. Perfect for optimizing websites, social media, and email attachments.
- [Image to PDF Converter](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/image-to-pdf): Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images into professional PDF documents. Arrange pages, set margins, and optimize file size for easy sharing.
- [Image Resizer](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/image-resizer): Change image dimensions in seconds. Resize by pixels or percentage, lock aspect ratios, and export in multiple formats for any project.
- [Image Converter](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/image-converter): Seamlessly convert between JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and AVIF. Support for modern formats and batch processing with zero quality loss.
- [Image Metadata Viewer](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/image-metadata-viewer): Peek behind the pixels. Extract and view EXIF, IPTC, and XMP data, including camera settings, GPS location, and timestamps.
- [Screenshot Editor](https://shauryatools.vercel.app/screenshot-editor): Annotate, redact, and enhance your screenshots. Add arrows, text, and blur sensitive information with a professional-grade markup tool.
